ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the image is “FOOD CHAIN”. In the lower left there is a flower labeled “FLOWER (Producer)”, and beside/below the flower there is a caterpillar labeled “CATERPILLAR (Consumer)”. The image also shows a frog, a snake, and an owl, with arrows continuing along the food chain from the caterpillar to the frog, then to the snake, then to the owl. Reasoning: Energy in the food chain starts from producers and is passed to the consumers that eat them. The flower is the producer, and the caterpillar is the first consumer that eats plants, so energy flows from the flower to the caterpillar.
